# Highlights Travel

> > Asia travel specialist offering private family tours and trip planning guides for Thailand, Bali, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Southeast Asia destinations.

Highlights Travel provides curated family-friendly tours across Asia, including multi-country itineraries and destination-specific packages. The site features comprehensive travel planning resources with weather guides, itinerary suggestions, and cultural insights for popular destinations like Bangkok, Bali, the Golden Triangle, and Himalayan regions.
